features.title: Focused hunter
features.text: Track a chosen prey and fight with a style shaped by your hunter's edge. Bows, paired weapons, companions and optional focus spells offer different approaches.

features.title: Hunt Prey
features.text: Choose a target to improve pursuit and apply your edge's specific benefits. Your feats can emphasize damage, knowledge, teamwork or a companion.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 4.5 → 4–5. Flurry and precision choices support excellent single-target damage; build determines the attack pattern.
ratings.defense: 3.5 → 3–4. Martial defenses are solid; feats, armor and engagement style shift resilience.
ratings.support: 2 → 2–4. Outwit, companion and shared-hunting options increase party support.
ratings.utility: 3 → 2–3. Tracking and perception are useful specialties; they do not imply broad skill mastery.
ratings.difficulty: 2.5 → 2.5. Hunt Prey is direct; companions and specialized combat routines add bookkeeping.
